1.asv: And Jehovah spake unto Moses, saying,

2.web: “Command the children of Israel, that they bring to you pure olive oil beaten for the light, to cause a lamp to burn continually.
2.asv: Command the children of Israel, that they bring unto thee pure olive oil beaten for the light, to cause a lamp to burn continually.

3.web: Outside of the veil of the Testimony, in the Tent of Meeting, shall Aaron keep it in order from evening to morning before Yahweh continually: it shall be a statute forever throughout your generations.
3.asv: Without the veil of the testimony, in the tent of meeting, shall Aaron keep it in order from evening to morning before Jehovah continually: it shall be a statute for ever throughout your generations.

4.web: He shall keep in order the lamps on the pure gold lamp stand before Yahweh continually.
4.asv: He shall keep in order the lamps upon the pure candlestick before Jehovah continually.

5.web: “You shall take fine flour, and bake twelve cakes of it: two tenth parts of an ephah shall be in one cake.
5.asv: And thou shalt take fine flour, and bake twelve cakes thereof: two tenth parts of an ephah shall be in one cake.

6.web: You shall set them in two rows, six on a row, on the pure gold table before Yahweh.
6.asv: And thou shalt set them in two rows, six on a row, upon the pure table before Jehovah.

7.web: You shall put pure frankincense on each row, that it may be to the bread for a memorial, even an offering made by fire to Yahweh.
7.asv: And thou shalt put pure frankincense upon each row, that it may be to the bread for a memorial, even an offering made by fire unto Jehovah.

8.web: Every Sabbath day he shall set it in order before Yahweh continually. It is on the behalf of the children of Israel an everlasting covenant.
8.asv: Every sabbath day he shall set it in order before Jehovah continually; it is on the behalf of the children of Israel, an everlasting covenant.

9.web: It shall be for Aaron and his sons; and they shall eat it in a holy place: for it is most holy to him of the offerings of Yahweh made by fire by a perpetual statute.”
9.asv: And it shall be for Aaron and his sons; and they shall eat it in a holy place: for it is most holy unto him of the offerings of Jehovah made by fire by a perpetual statute.

10.web: The son of an Israelite woman, whose father was an Egyptian, went out among the children of Israel; and the son of the Israelite woman and a man of Israel strove together in the camp.
10.asv: And the son of an Israelitish woman, whose father was an Egyptian, went out among the children of Israel; and the son of the Israelitish woman and a man of Israel strove together in the camp:

11.web: The son of the Israelite woman blasphemed the Name, and cursed; and they brought him to Moses. His mother’s name was Shelomith, the daughter of Dibri, of the tribe of Dan.
11.asv: and the son of the Israelitish woman blasphemed the Name, and cursed; and they brought him unto Moses. And his mother’s name was Shelomith, the daughter of Dibri, of the tribe of Dan.

12.web: They put him in custody, until Yahweh’s will should be declared to them.
12.asv: And they put him in ward, that it might be declared unto them at the mouth of Jehovah.

13.asv: And Jehovah spake unto Moses, saying,

14.web: “Bring out of the camp him who cursed; and let all who heard him lay their hands on his head, and let all the congregation stone him.
14.asv: Bring forth him that hath cursed without the camp; and let all that heard him lay their hands upon his head, and let all the congregation stone him.

15.web: You shall speak to the children of Israel, saying, ‘Whoever curses his God shall bear his sin.
15.asv: And thou shalt speak unto the children of Israel, saying, Whosoever curseth his God shall bear his sin.

16.web: He who blasphemes Yahweh’s name, he shall surely be put to death. All the congregation shall certainly stone him. The foreigner as well as the native-born, when he blasphemes the Name, shall be put to death.
16.asv: And he that blasphemeth the name of Jehovah, he shall surely be put to death; all the congregation shall certainly stone him: as well the sojourner, as the home-born, when he blasphemeth the name of Jehovah, shall be put to death.

17.web: “‘He who strikes any man mortally shall surely be put to death.
17.asv: And he that smiteth any man mortally shall surely be put to death.

18.web: He who strikes an animal mortally shall make it good, life for life.
18.asv: And he that smiteth a beast mortally shall make it good, life for life.

19.web: If anyone injures his neighbor; as he has done, so shall it be done to him:
19.asv: And if a man cause a blemish in his neighbor; as he hath done, so shall it be done to him:

20.web: fracture for fracture, eye for eye, tooth for tooth; as he has injured someone, so shall it be done to him.
20.asv: breach for breach, eye for eye, tooth for tooth; as he hath caused a blemish in a man, so shall it be rendered unto him.

21.web: He who kills an animal shall make it good; and he who kills a man shall be put to death.
21.asv: And he that killeth a beast shall make it good: and he that killeth a man shall be put to death.

22.web: You shall have one kind of law for the foreigner as well as the native-born; for I am Yahweh your God.’”
22.asv: Ye shall have one manner of law, as well for the sojourner, as for the home-born: for I am Jehovah your God.

23.web: Moses spoke to the children of Israel; and they brought out him who had cursed out of the camp, and stoned him with stones. The children of Israel did as Yahweh commanded Moses.
23.asv: And Moses spake to the children of Israel; and they brought forth him that had cursed out of the camp, and stoned him with stones. And the children of Israel did as Jehovah commanded Moses.
